scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w apps/api && npm run test:e2e -w apps/web
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov -w apps/api && npm run test:cov -w apps/web
